blocks.text: 1 Samuel 7 contains 17 verses. It opens with: And the men of Kiriath-jearim came, and fetched up the ark of Jehovah, and brought it into the house of Abinadab in the hill, and sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of Jehovah. It concludes with: And his return was to Ramah, for there was his house; and there he judged Israel: and he built there an altar unto Jehovah. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: First Samuel moves from Eli's failing priestly house through Samuel's prophetic leadership and Saul's rejected kingship to David's anointing, rise, exile, and Saul's death.
